About

Hi! I'm Gabrielle — a writer, artist, and architecture student based in South Africa. This site is my personal scrapbook: a place to share poems, essays, sketches, photographs, and the architecture projects I'm most proud of.

I built this site so I'd always have somewhere to put everything — the written and the drawn and the built. Pull up a chair. Stay a while.

When I'm not writing or drawing, you'll find me in studio with trace paper and too many coffee cups, or out looking for interesting buildings to photograph.

"To design is to communicate clearly." — Milton Glaser
"Architecture is the thoughtful making of space." — Louis Kahn
